## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

[All Early Phase Clinical Services][140]

## At the Speed of Science

Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories in Lincoln, NE and Zurich, Switzerland are equipped with the
latest technologies for PK, immunogenicity, and biomarker assays to provide regulated support at all
phases of drug development.

[Learn More][147]

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

## The Future of Pharmacy

We’ve got our eyes set on the future. We’re taking research higher, discoveries further, and
translating science into medicine day by day.

[Learn More][155]

## Therapeutic Expertise Areas

### Focused on Strong Science and Flawless Execution

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to
handle every aspect of your product’s early development—no matter the type of drug or clinical
trial. These are some of the many specialties we’ve cultivated over the years, to provide fast,
innovative solutions for your drug’s development.

[AGILE ICON][AGILE ICON]

#### AGILE

Speed is part of our name. We optimize our studies for speed and efficiency at every stage, to
generate actionable data faster than our competitors.

[EXPERIENCED ICON][EXPERIENCED ICON]

#### EXPERIENCED

Our 50+ years of experience conducting 6,000+ studies ensures the collection of quality data through
efficient and effective study designs.

[GLOBAL ICON][GLOBAL ICON]

#### GLOBAL

With facilities across North America, Europe, and Asia, in 30 countries worldwide, we conduct trials
with the right patients, in the right places, to get the data you need.

[INNOVATIVE ICON][INNOVATIVE ICON]

#### INNOVATIVE

From data acquisition strategies to advanced facilities, we lead the way in leveraging new
technology to provide faster, more accurate data, at less cost.

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

phases of drug development.

## Bioanalytical Sciences

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug
developers from pre-clinical through late-stage clinical testing. Learn how our experienced
scientific teams can provide custom, phase-appropriate bioanalytical solutions for your program.

### Focused on Strong Science and Flawless Execution

Between our comprehensive services and decades of therapeutic experience, we have the expertise to
handle every aspect of your product’s early development—no matter the type of drug or clinical
trial. These are some of the many specialties we’ve cultivated over the years, to provide fast,

## A Trusted Partner of Life Science Research and the Biopharmaceutical Industry


We are living in the bio-century. Global medical knowledge is expanding at a rapid pace. But despite
huge breakthroughs, many diseases, such as cancer, rheumatism or Alzheimer's, are still not
curable.  Sartorius is part of the solution.

We help to ensure that new scientific discoveries can be translated more quickly into effective
patient care. With technologies, platforms and partnerships for a common goal: better health for
more people.

Trouble installing/running Cheat Engine? Check out the [known github issue][20] here on how to solve
it, or join the [cheat engine patreon][21]

Do you wish to mod your games, but you do not like cheating? Then try [Runtime Modifier][22] it's
not cheating if you call it modding!

Read before download: You must be 18 years or older, or deemed an adult, to install Cheat Engine.
Cheat engine is for private and educational purposes only. Before you attach Cheat Engine to a
process, please make sure that you are not violating the EULA/TOS of the specific game/application.
cheatengine.org does not condone the illegal use of Cheat Engine

**May 29 2026:**Cheat Engine 7.7 Released for Windows, Mac and Linux for [Patreons][23]

It took a bit too long for a new public release. (Sorry about that but the wait will be worth it).
But there's finally a new version of cheat engine out
My patreon members can get it [here][24]

(̶T̶h̶e̶ ̶p̶u̶b̶l̶i̶c̶ ̶w̶i̶n̶d̶o̶w̶s̶ ̶r̶e̶l̶e̶a̶s̶e̶ ̶w̶i̶l̶l̶ ̶c̶o̶m̶e̶ ̶i̶n̶ ̶a̶ ̶f̶e̶w̶ ̶d̶a̶y̶s̶)̶
The public version is out now as well: [Link][25]

For those wondering why they get an update notification even though they got 7.7 before: There was a
small patch regarding performance and a bug related to the disassembler. That should be fixed now

Please reports bugs and give suggestions to improve Cheat Engine so next version can be even
greater!


patches after initial release (Your CE version will tell you there is an update, even if you're on
7.7):

updated the windows build to fix an issue with creating a process using the processwindow

fixed an issue with disassembling invalid vex instructions

Fixed a lag issue with symbols

Fixed memoryleak in lua command getFunctionRange

Fixed 32-bit VEH debug issue and loading old tables by certain table makers

Fixed structure dissect issue when autodelete is used in combination with internal types , and fixed
HOOK/HOOK5 not setting the preferred allocation

26-06-2026: linux version patches

**Changes**:

Memrec class now has an OnActivationFailure callback

globalalloc symbols do not save in tables anymore

added static field address lookup for .net core and microsoft clr

script tag can now be hidden

Lua: Added methods for OrderedList objects. Useful for accessing the History object of
disassemblerview and hexview

Lua: LuaEngine windows now have their own luastate so breakpointed states won't get messed up by
potential timers or other luaengine dialogs

fpu debug dialog now shows when values change while stepping

speedhack: mono/il2cpp with unity now should freeze the game when the game sets the speed to 0

dotnetinfo: added an enumstatic dialog

find what addresses this code accesses: changed the color of blue in the darkmode dialog

New table specific options

added completion to lua code in auto assembler

You can now dissect structures directly from dotnetinfo

added modulePreference for symbol loading. When multiple modules have the same symbol, this list
determines which modules has priority. (Already populated for windows and linux)

break and trace: new option to break on trace stop

break and trace: trace until initial function exit

threadname support

waitForallsymbols now shows a dialog when it takes too long

custom types of the integer variant are now 8 byte in 64-bit CE

added several new custom type examples/templates

added a .net 8 example plugin

more info now has tabs

AutoAssembler: added {$ifdef} /{$endif} and {$ifndef}/{$endif} blocks

mono method lookup now supports generics and parameters

AutoAssembler command: Hook(address, addresstogoto, originalcode) where originalcode will be
allocated and filled for you

AutoAssembler command: unhook(address)

AutoAssembler command: aobscanfunction(name, functionstart, aob)

Mono: Better class/method lookup (generic support and parameters for methods)

lua:registerSymbolLookupCallback functions now also have access to the original string as well (only
use it to determine if you should return nil or not)

dotnetdatacollector now takes less time to determine if something is an object in the heap or not

memoryviewer has a new 'marker' type of highlights also controllable from lua.

memoryviewer has a new function to highlight all lines that are used as a jump destination so it's
easier to determine where to hook

.net plugins: The .net 9 runtime requirements also link with aspnetcore

added OnMouseWheelEvent support

added AI commands

ported CE to linux

.net info static field now has a context menu to copy the data

Added binary notation in aobscan |010

Mapping, Knowledge Representation, knowledge model, knowledge elicitation, education, CmapServer. **
** IHMC CmapTools (http://cmap.ihmc.us/) program empowers users to construct, navigate, share and
criticize knowledge models represented as concept maps. IHMC CmapTools facilitates the manipulation
of Concept Maps. It allows users to construct their Cmaps in their personal computer, share them on
servers (CmapServers) anywhere on the Internet, link their Cmaps to other Cmaps on servers,
automatically create web pages of their concept maps on servers, edit their maps synchronously (at
the same time) with other users on the Internet, and search the web for information relevant to a
concept map. Software Toolkit is composed of CmapTools Program and CmapServer ** **************

## WEEE Distributor Take Back Scheme

**RECYCLING YOUR OLD ELECTRICALS IS EASY!**

Recycle your electrical and electronic devices for free at your local recycling centre (UK Only). To
find your nearest recycling centre visit the Recycle More website and enter your postcode.

**WHY SHOULD YOU RECYCLE?**

Unwanted electrical equipment is the UK’s fastest growing type of waste. Many electrical items can
be repaired or recycled, saving natural resources and the environment. To remind you that old
electrical equipment can be recycled it is marked with a crossed out wheelie bin symbol. Please do
not throw any electrical equipment (including those marked with this symbol) in your bin.

**WHAT IS WEEE?**

The Waste Electrical or Electronic Equipment (WEEE) Directive required countries to maximise
separate collection and environmentally friendly processing of these items.

**HOW ARE DSE HELPING?**

In the UK, suppliers of electronics, such as DSE must provide a system which allows all customers
buying new electrical equipment the opportunity to recycle old items free of charge. As a
responsible supplier, we have met the requirements placed on us by financially supporting the
network of WEEE recycling centres established by local authorities. This is achieved by supporting
through membership of the national Distributor Take Back Scheme (DTS). To find out more information
on WEEE recycling and to locate your nearest recycling centre please visit the [Recycle More][167]
website.

## WEEE Distributor Take Back Scheme

**RECYCLING YOUR OLD ELECTRICALS IS EASY!**

Recycle your electrical and electronic devices for free at your local recycling centre (UK Only). To
find your nearest recycling centre visit the Recycle More website and enter your postcode.

**WHY SHOULD YOU RECYCLE?**

Unwanted electrical equipment is the UK’s fastest growing type of waste. Many electrical items can
be repaired or recycled, saving natural resources and the environment. To remind you that old
electrical equipment can be recycled it is marked with a crossed out wheelie bin symbol. Please do
not throw any electrical equipment (including those marked with this symbol) in your bin.

**WHAT IS WEEE?**

The Waste Electrical or Electronic Equipment (WEEE) Directive required countries to maximise
separate collection and environmentally friendly processing of these items.

**HOW ARE DSE HELPING?**

In the UK, suppliers of electronics, such as DSE must provide a system which allows all customers
buying new electrical equipment the opportunity to recycle old items free of charge. As a
responsible supplier, we have met the requirements placed on us by financially supporting the
network of WEEE recycling centres established by local authorities. This is achieved by supporting
through membership of the national Distributor Take Back Scheme (DTS). To find out more information
on WEEE recycling and to locate your nearest recycling centre please visit the [Recycle More][167]
website.

# Enabling South Africa’s Omics Research Community

DIPLOMICS (DIstributed PLatform in OMICS) is a research infrastructure programme funded by The
Department of Science, Technology and Innovation.

[TELL ME MORE][35]

### DIPLOMICS

### IMPACTS

[EXPLORE ALL][36]

To Give Her Wings - The Story of Birdie Rose

The Birdie-Rose case underscores the need for coordinated efforts among specialists in diagnosing
and treating patients with rare diseases. Birdie was nearly six years old when she received her
diagnosis.

The journey of one family affected by UNC80 deficiency

South Africa’s fragmented rare disease care is shifting through genome sequencing and the Nngwe
programme, but treatments remain scarce—this is one family’s journey with UNC80 deficiency.

Unravelling the Secrets of the Red Roman | 1KSA and the Quest for Marine Conservation

Meet Dr Romina Henriques and PhD candidate Mannda Ndou from the University of Pretoria, along with
their team, as they delve deep into the genetics of the Red Roman - Chrysoblephus laticeps, a vital
species for South Africa’s marine biodiversity.

Discovering the Genetic Secrets of the Cape Grysbok

Join Prof. Paulette Bloomer from the University of Pretoria, Dr Deon de Jager from the University of
Copenhagen, and Dr Anri Van Wyk from the University of Pretoria as they delve into the fascinating
world of the Cape Grysbok - Raphicerus melanotis.

research around us.

# Home

### ศูนย์วิจัยและพัฒนาเทคโนโลยีนิวเคลียร์ (ศน.)
* [Dr. Thitirat Rattanawongwiboon of Material Science Lab]
  Dr. Thitirat Rattanawongwiboon of Material Science Lab
* ขอแสดงความยินดีกับนักวิจัย จากศูนย์วิจัยและพัฒนาเทคโนโลยีนิวเคลียร์ สทน. ที่คว้ารางวัลการวิจัยแห่งชาติ ประจำปีงบประมาณ
  2569 จากสำนักงานการวิจัยแห่งชาติ (วช.) ซึ่งประกาศผลเมื่อวันที่ 28 พฤศจิกายน 2568 จำนวนรวม 7 ผลงาน
* [[Vichai Puripunyavanich in the tissue culture lab. His research teams focuses on plant mutation
  breeding using ionizing radiation to develop novel varieties with desired traits.]][18]
  Vichai Puripunyavanich in the tissue culture lab. His research teams focuses on plant mutation
  breeding using ionizing radiation to develop novel varieties with desired traits.
* [[ดร. ศักดิ์ชัย หลักสี
  กับงานวิจัยการประยุกต์ใช้เทคโนโลยีนิวเคลียร์ในกระบวนการสังเคราะห์วัสดุขั้นสูงเพื่อพลิกโฉมวงการนาโนเทคโนโลยีและนวัตกรรมสีเ
  ขียวสู่อนาคตที่ยั่งยืน จากระบบนำส่งยานาโนไฮบริดที่ช่วยเสริมฤทธิ์ต้านมะเร็งอย่างทรงประสิทธิภาพ
  สู่เทคโนโลยีเม็ดบีดกักเก็บสารออกฤทธิ์ที่ช่วยยืดอายุผักและผลไม้ และวัสดุตัวเร่งปฏิกิริยาเชิงแสงที่ช่วยบำบัดน้ำเสีย
  ซึ่งเทคโนโลยีรังสีคือพลังขับเคลื่อนการสร้างวัสดุนาโนอัจฉริยะเพื่อสุขภาพ อาหาร และสิ่งแวดล้อมอย่างยั่งยืน]][19]
  ดร. ศักดิ์ชัย หลักสี สังเคราะห์วัสดุขั้นสูงด้วยเทคโนโลยีนิวเคลียร์เพื่อนวัตกรรมสีเขียวสู่อนาคตที่ยั่งยืน รวมถึงสารต้านมะเร็ง
  สารออกฤทธิ์ที่ช่วยยืดอายุผักและผลไม้ และวัสดุช่วยบำบัดน้ำเสีย
* [[ดร. ธนกร แสงทวีสิน มุ่งมั่นพัฒนาการใช้ประโยชน์ผักตบชวาโดยกระบวนการทางรังสี เพื่อการสังเคราะวัสดุคาร์บอนขนาดจิ๋ว
  (carbon dots) ด้วยรังสีแกมมา ที่สามารถนำไปใช้ประโยชน์ที่หลากหลาย อาทิ ฟิล์มกรองแสง ฟิล์มถนอมอาหาร
  แผ่นเยื่อเลือกผ่านเพื่อเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพการนำไฟฟ้าในตัวเก็บประจุ และ อีกมากมาย]][20]
  ดร. ธนกร แสงทวีสิน มุ่งมั่นพัฒนาการใช้ประโยชน์ผักตบชวาโดยกระบวนการทางรังสี เพื่อการสังเคราะวัสดุคาร์บอนขนาดจิ๋ว
  (carbon dots) ด้วยรังสีแกมมา ที่สามารถนำไปใช้ประโยชน์ที่หลากหลาย อาทิ ฟิล์มกรองแสง ฟิล์มถนอมอาหาร
  แผ่นเยื่อเลือกผ่านเพื่อเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพการนำไฟฟ้าในตัวเก็บประจุ และ อีกมากมาย
* [[Dr. Waleeporn Pongkua and her research on rice cultivation for greenhouse gas reduction.]][21]
  Dr. Waleeporn Pongkua and her research on rice cultivation for greenhouse gas reduction.

#### ยินดีต้อนรับ

#### Welcome, Willkommen, Bienvenido,
#### Selamat datang, ようこそ (yokoso), 어서 오세요 (eoseo oseyo)

Welcome to the homepage of TINT Nuclear Technology Research and Development Center (NTRDC). We are a
group of researchers working on nuclear science and its applications. We hope you find the
information here useful. Learn [about us,][22] our [research][23], get to know [our staffs][24] and
[facilities][25]. We are open for collaboration. Feel free to get in touch with us for details.

ศน. ประกอบด้วยกลุ่มนักวิจัยและพัฒนาที่ทำงานด้านวิทยาศาสตร์นิวเคลียร์ในหลายมิติ เพื่อมุ่งเน้นการใช้ประโยชน์ในด้านต่าง ๆ
หวังว่าคุณจะได้รับข้อมูลความรู้ที่มีประโยชน์จากเวบไซต์นี้ หากท่านมีข้อสงสัยใด ๆ สามารถติดต่อ ศน.

  ขียวสู่อนาคตที่ยั่งยืน จากระบบนำส่งยานาโนไฮบริดที่ช่วยเสริมฤทธิ์ต้านมะเร็งอย่างทรงประสิทธิภาพ

  สารออกฤทธิ์ที่ช่วยยืดอายุผักและผลไม้ และวัสดุช่วยบำบัดน้ำเสีย

  แผ่นเยื่อเลือกผ่านเพื่อเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพการนำไฟฟ้าในตัวเก็บประจุ และ อีกมากมาย]][20]

You can register on our website using the exact company name that is on your company's W-9 or
corporate return. Start off by verify your company's address, fill in appropriate boxes, then click
submit. Once you are you registered you can access the website features.

What if I forgot my username/password?

your account information. If you forget your email address, please contact your sales
representative.

EquipNet has been revolutionizing the way companies manage their surplus assets for over two
decades. Our clients range in size from small businesses to Fortune 500 multi-national corporations.
We manage the entire sales and redeployment process, handling a single piece of equipment, or
managing your global investment and redeployment program, including plant closures.

## Buy Equipment

EquipNet is the largest online venue for pre-owned manufacturing, packaging, laboratory, test,
electronics, and facility support equipment. Shop 1,000+ equipment categories across 3 sales
channels.

[MarketPlace™][85]

[Auctions][86]

[Own It Now™][87]

## Sell Equipment

Whether it’s a site closure, a facility reorganization, or simply surplus equipment, EquipNet will
manage the sales process ensuring maximum cash value recovered.

[List an Item for Sale][88]

[List Multiple Items For Sale][89]

[Plant Closures & Projects][90]

## Manage Equipment

EquipNet’s proprietary technology (ARMS™), along with turnkey capabilities deliver a professionally
managed investment recovery and redeployment program.

[Global Programs][91]

[Regional Programs][92]

[Multiple Plant Programs][93]

## Integrated Laboratory Services

Asset Management, Compliance, Operations & Transitions

## Client Success Stories

### Biotech/Pharmaceutical Facility Closure: Massachusetts

One of our previous project clients recommended our services to Synta Pharmaceuticals to help with
closing a facility consisting of three different buildings. The entire facility needed full
clearance and contained an array of over 400 pieces of R&D equipment.
[Read More][105]

### The Success of Buying & Selling Equipment with EquipNet

EquipNet is constantly working on asset disposition projects with multiple clients across the globe
to help companies buy, sell, and manage their surplus. This case study outlines how EquipNet was
able to help our long-term client buying and selling. 
[Read More][106]

### Cookie Production Line: Colombia

This client originally sought out an auctioneer company to help sell a cookie production line from a
facility in Colombia. When the company was unsuccessful in its efforts, the auctioneer directly
reached out to EquipNet for expert assistance. 
[Read More][107]
[View More][108]

Be the first to know about new equipment, upcoming auctions, and other services that might be
beneficial to your needs. Register now and save time when you want to buy or sell equipment.

[[Analītiskā hromatogrāfija un sadalīšanas procesi]][13]

Žāvskapji, inkubatori, klimata kameras, ūdens vannas

Cirkulatori, dzesētāji, sildītāji

## Your team has ideas,
## your agents have capabilities,
## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

## Millions build with HackMD's Markdown editor every day

Powering teams around the world, from next-generation startups to established institutions

## Built for the team, open to your agents

Your workspace, where humans collaborate and agents can keep up

#### Write together, think together, ship together

Real-time editing with multiple cursors, comments, version history, and GitHub sync. Everything your
team already counts on, every day.
* [Live editing with multiple cursors][14]
* [Comments & mentions][15]
* [Version history][16]
* [Templates][17]
* [GitHub integration][18]
Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.
[
Explore features][19]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][20]
* [Embeds][21]
* [Slide mode][22]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.

See community stories][23]

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.
* Pull any note as Markdown via REST API or CLI
* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

Teams are using HackMD's API to feed their agents context, automate note creation, and keep
documentation in sync.

## Your team has ideas,

## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

Scilit publishes a Top Cited Scholars and Top Cited Young Scholars list annually to recognize

young scholars to contribute their scientific research. Explore the Top Cited Scholars 2025 list.

Scilit is a free and comprehensive scholarly publication database, indexing 190 million scholarly
publications, including over 48 million open access articles and 8 million preprints. New
publications are typically covered within hours. Watch the video to know Scilit in one minute.

We, S V Scientific Private Limited, are bringing forth innovation at industry leading prices. Today,
we hold a special position in the sector, and are considered a highly experienced business concern.
As a talented distributor and supplier of India, we are aiming to become the most preferred name in
the market in coming years. To accomplish our goal, we are working under the leadership of two
qualified engineers Mr. Shashidhar Besur and Mr. Vivek B. R. They motivate us to present the best
items to scientists, research facilities and analytical labs at all times. To meet the exact
equipment requirements of such application areas, we procure a reliable and durable assortment from
trusted vendors of India as well as many foreign countries. We quality test all the procured

on time. We are a trusted partner to many pharmaceutical, biotechnology, industrial & medical
research and other institutes across the country. We are backed by 20 principle agencies that help
us in catering to such different segments of the market.

manner. To perform in such a manner, we comply to the fair trade laws as well as quality standards
of the country. Regularly, we focus on improving our working style and range for the benefit of
clients.

quality service to our precious clients. The procured stock of products is stored at our Bangalore
based warehouse prior to sale. From there, we ship our Ecocell Laboratory Incubators, Laboratory
Autoclaves, etc., swiftly to each and every corner of the country.

**About Us**

We, S V Scientific Private Limited, are bringing forth innovation at industry leading prices. Today,
we hold a special position in the sector, and are considered a highly experienced business concern.
As a talented distributor and supplier of India, we are aiming to become the most preferred name in
the market in coming years. To accomplish our goal, we are working under the leadership of two
qualified engineers Mr. Shashidhar Besur and Mr. Vivek B. R. They motivate us to present the best
items to scientists, research facilities and analytical labs at all times. To meet the exact
equipment requirements of such application areas, we procure a reliable and durable assortment from
trusted vendors of India as well as many foreign countries. We quality test all the procured
Laboratory Autoclaves, Unisteri Hp IL Steam Sterilizers, Capillary Electrophoresis Systems, Ecocell
Laboratory Incubators, Laboratory Autoclaves, Vertical Autoclaves, etc., and deliver them to clients
on time. We are a trusted partner to many pharmaceutical, biotechnology, industrial & medical
research and other institutes across the country. We are backed by 20 principle agencies that help
us in catering to such different segments of the market.

**Our Principle**

The core principle of our enterprise is to attain maximum customer satisfaction in the most ethical
manner. To perform in such a manner, we comply to the fair trade laws as well as quality standards
of the country. Regularly, we focus on improving our working style and range for the benefit of
clients. 

**Our Infrastructure **

Our enterprise own offices in different cities of India, and these outlets allow us to render
quality service to our precious clients. The procured stock of products is stored at our Bangalore
based warehouse prior to sale. From there, we ship our Ecocell Laboratory Incubators, Laboratory
Autoclaves, etc., swiftly to each and every corner of the country. 

**Events**

Our company has participated in the following events in the past years: 

* **In 2016:**
* * Pharmalytica, India Lab Expo & Analytica Anacon
  * Technical Training At MMM Medcenter, Brno, Czech Republic
* **In 2018:**
* * HITEX, Hyderabad
  * India Lab Expo & Analytica Anacon India 
  * BEC, Mumbai
* **In 2019:**
* * HITEX, Hyderabad

**Clients**

Our company takes proper care of the clients who bestow trust on our name. We make sure that each
client is supported by a quality array as well as reliable customer support. We aim to provide
maximum gratification to them. This focus on benefiting client has led to the success of our
enterprise among clients. Today, we are supported by a huge clientele including names like:

* IIT
* IIS
* DRDO
* ISRO
* ICMR
* ICAR
* CSIR & more

**A Well Connected Dealer!**

We are a strategically connected dealer, and have partnered up with the best to provide maximum
profits to our clients. Our company is an authorized dealer of: 

* LAUDA Product Groups
* Miles Scientific 
* ARCTIKO 
* Biometrics Technologies, Inc.
* CERI 
* Filtra Vibraci S.L. 
* GFL GmbH, etc.
